Subject: Vendor onboarding: requests for tax forms (W-9 / W-8BEN-E) and VAT details

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for agreeing to be added as an approved supplier for Redwood. To finish finance onboarding and enable PO creation, we need the following from LumenWare: 

- Completed and signed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities) — PDF preferred
- VAT registration certificate (if applicable)
- Legal entity name exactly as appears on your bank account and W-8/W-9
- Point of contact for invoice submission + remit-to email

You can upload documents directly to our supplier portal (link below) or reply to this thread with attachments. If you prefer DocuSign, I can send the envelope. Goal: have documents in by end of week so Finance can open a PO and set up payment terms.

Portal link: https://redwood-supplier-portal.example.com/intake/LMN-3482
DocuSign: let me know if you want me to send.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (see required fields)

Thanks — quick items below to help prioritize: 
- W-8BEN-E or W-9 (required)
- VAT cert (if you charge VAT)
- Bank account name and SWIFT/IBAN for cross-border payments

Regards,
Jasmine Liu

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood procurement checklist + PO timing

Hi Sarah — looping in a couple procurement items so we can move to PO creation once docs are verified. 

Checklist for Finance to approve and issue PO (we've already started intake):
- Signed W-9 (matches legal entity on bank statement) — required
- Completed supplier profile in portal (business address, remit-to email, ACH/Bank details)
- Internal approvals (security/compliance sign-off not required for this supplier)
- Standard T&C acknowledgement (we'll attach our PO terms)

DocuSign option: I can send the W-9 + T&C envelope if you're short on time. That speeds things up. Otherwise uploading to the portal is fine. Please name uploads with this pattern: LumenWare_Redwood_ONB_YYYYMMDD.pdf — helps us track versions.

PO timing: once we have the verified W-9 and bank info, Finance typically issues a PO within 2 business days. If you need the PO earlier for scheduling, say so and we can expedite. 

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Procurement Coordinator | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachments: Redwood_PO_template.pdf (sample PO + payment terms)
